(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* SAVITZKY-GOLAY 5-POINT FILTER & CHROMATOGRAPHIC PEAK DERIVATIVES                                     *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Roll History Buffers (Window index 0 is newest, 4 is oldest) *)
arrUV260_Window[4] := arrUV260_Window[3];
arrUV260_Window[3] := arrUV260_Window[2];
arrUV260_Window[2] := arrUV260_Window[1];
arrUV260_Window[1] := arrUV260_Window[0];
arrUV260_Window[0] := rUV260_Voted_mAU - rBaselineOffset260_mAU;

arrUV280_Window[4] := arrUV280_Window[3];
arrUV280_Window[3] := arrUV280_Window[2];
arrUV280_Window[2] := arrUV280_Window[1];
arrUV280_Window[1] := arrUV280_Window[0];
arrUV280_Window[0] := rUV280_Voted_mAU - rBaselineOffset280_mAU;

arrCond_Window[4] := arrCond_Window[3];
arrCond_Window[3] := arrCond_Window[2];
arrCond_Window[2] := arrCond_Window[1];
arrCond_Window[1] := arrCond_Window[0];
arrCond_Window[0] := rBlendedConductivity_mScm;

(* Compute Savitzky-Golay 2nd Order Polynomial Smoothing & Derivatives *)
(* Gram Polynomial Filter Coefficients for N=5, M=2 *)
rUV260_Smoothed_mAU := ((-3.0 * arrUV260_Window[4]) + (12.0 * arrUV260_Window[3]) + (17.0 * arrUV260_Window[2]) + (12.0 * arrUV260_Window[1]) - (3.0 * arrUV260_Window[0])) / 35.0;

IF rCycleTime_s > 0.001 THEN
    (* 1st Derivative (Slope) d(UV)/dt *)
    rUV260_Slope_mAUs := ((-2.0 * arrUV260_Window[4]) - (1.0 * arrUV260_Window[3]) + (0.0 * arrUV260_Window[2]) + (1.0 * arrUV260_Window[1]) + (2.0 * arrUV260_Window[0])) / (10.0 * rCycleTime_s);
    
    (* 2nd Derivative (Curvature) d2(UV)/dt2 *)
    rUV260_Curvature_mAUs2 := ((2.0 * arrUV260_Window[4]) - (1.0 * arrUV260_Window[3]) - (2.0 * arrUV260_Window[2]) - (1.0 * arrUV260_Window[1]) + (2.0 * arrUV260_Window[0])) / (7.0 * rCycleTime_s * rCycleTime_s);

    rUV280_Smoothed_mAU := ((-3.0 * arrUV280_Window[4]) + (12.0 * arrUV280_Window[3]) + (17.0 * arrUV280_Window[2]) + (12.0 * arrUV280_Window[1]) - (3.0 * arrUV280_Window[0])) / 35.0;
    rUV280_Slope_mAUs := ((-2.0 * arrUV280_Window[4]) - (1.0 * arrUV280_Window[3]) + (0.0 * arrUV280_Window[2]) + (1.0 * arrUV280_Window[1]) + (2.0 * arrUV280_Window[0])) / (10.0 * rCycleTime_s);
    rUV280_Curvature_mAUs2 := ((2.0 * arrUV280_Window[4]) - (1.0 * arrUV280_Window[3]) - (2.0 * arrUV280_Window[2]) - (1.0 * arrUV280_Window[1]) + (2.0 * arrUV280_Window[0])) / (7.0 * rCycleTime_s * rCycleTime_s);
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Peak Feature Extraction Logic *)
bPeakLiftoffDetected := (rUV260_Smoothed_mAU > 12.0) AND (rUV260_Slope_mAUs > 0.85);

(* Apex detection: slope crosses zero downwards with substantial negative curvature *)
bPeakApexDetected := (rPriorUV260_Slope_mAUs > 0.0) AND (rUV260_Slope_mAUs <= 0.0) AND (rUV260_Curvature_mAUs2 < -0.15);

(* Valley nadir detection: slope crosses zero upwards between resolving peaks with positive curvature *)
bValleyNadirDetected := (rPriorUV260_Slope_mAUs < 0.0) AND (rUV260_Slope_mAUs >= 0.0) AND (rUV260_Curvature_mAUs2 > 0.15);

(* Baseline return detection *)
bBaselineReturnDetected := (rUV260_Smoothed_mAU < 6.0) AND (ABS(rUV260_Slope_mAUs) < 0.25);

(* DUAL-WAVELENGTH IN-LINE UV RATIO & BEER-LAMBERT MATRIX DECONVOLUTION                                 *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate Stoichiometric Absorbance Ratio *)

(* Analytical Matrix Inversion for 2-Component Capsid Mass Resolution *)
(* [A260 / 1000] = (eps260_F * C_F + eps260_E * C_E) * L *)
(* [A280 / 1000] = (eps280_F * C_F + eps280_E * C_E) * L *)
IF (ABS(rMatrixDeterminant) > 0.0001) AND (rPathLength_cm > 0.01) THEN
    rDeconvolutedFull_mgmL := ((rEpsilon_280_Empty * (rUV260_Smoothed_mAU * 0.0010)) - 
                               (rEpsilon_260_Empty * (rUV280_Smoothed_mAU * 0.0010))) / 
                              (rMatrixDeterminant * rPathLength_cm);

    rDeconvolutedEmpty_mgmL := ((-rEpsilon_280_Full * (rUV260_Smoothed_mAU * 0.0010)) + 
                                (rEpsilon_260_Full * (rUV280_Smoothed_mAU * 0.0010))) / 
                               (rMatrixDeterminant * rPathLength_cm);
END_IF;

(* Non-Negative Constraint Bounds Clamping *)
IF rDeconvolutedFull_mgmL < 0.0 THEN rDeconvolutedFull_mgmL := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rDeconvolutedEmpty_mgmL < 0.0 THEN rDeconvolutedEmpty_mgmL := 0.0; END_IF;

rCapsidConcentration_Full_mgmL := rDeconvolutedFull_mgmL;
rCapsidConcentration_Empty_mgmL := rDeconvolutedEmpty_mgmL;
rDeconvolutedTotal_mgmL := rDeconvolutedFull_mgmL + rDeconvolutedEmpty_mgmL;

IF rDeconvolutedTotal_mgmL > 0.002 THEN
    rCapsidFullPurity_pct := (rDeconvolutedFull_mgmL / rDeconvolutedTotal_mgmL) * 100.0;
    rCapsidEmptyPurity_pct := (rDeconvolutedEmpty_mgmL / rDeconvolutedTotal_mgmL) * 100.0;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* QUATERNARY AMMONIUM RESIN BINDING FRONT TRACKING & BOHART-ADAMS MODEL                                *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate Incremental and Cumulative Hydraulic Volume *)

    (* Resin Bed Saturation Fraction *)
    IF rResinBedCapacityTotal_vg > 0.0 THEN
        rResinBindingSaturation_pct := (rCumulatedLoadedGenome_vg / rResinBedCapacityTotal_vg) * 100.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Bohart-Adams Breakthrough Model: ln(C/C0 - 1) = (k*N0*Z)/v - k*C0*t *)
    IF (rInstantaneousPoreVelocity_cm_s > 0.001) AND (rLoadAAVTiter_vgmL > 0.0) THEN
        rTempCalcA := ((rMassTransferCoeff_ka_s1 * rResinStaticBindingCap_vgmL * rResinBedHeight_cm) / 
                       (rInstantaneousPoreVelocity_cm_s * 1.0E12)) - 
                      ((rMassTransferCoeff_ka_s1 * (rLoadAAVTiter_vgmL / 1.0E12) * rStateTimer_s));
        
        IF rTempCalcA > 35.0 THEN
            rCurrentBreakthroughFrac := 0.00001; (* Extremely tight binding near column inlet *)
        ELSIF rTempCalcA < -35.0 THEN
            rCurrentBreakthroughFrac := 0.99999; (* Breakthrough front fully saturated *)
        ELSE
            rCurrentBreakthroughFrac := 1.0 / (1.0 + EXP(rTempCalcA));
        END_IF;
    END_IF;

    (* Trigger Saturation Warning Before Breakaway Loss of Vector *)
    IF (rCurrentBreakthroughFrac >= rCriticalBreakthroughFrac) OR (rResinBindingSaturation_pct >= 85.0) THEN
        bBindingSaturationWarning := TRUE;
        wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Dynamic Binding Capacity Exceeded *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCurrentBreakthroughFrac := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* STATE-SPACE PROPAGATION & RECEDING-HORIZON MPC QUADRATIC SOLVER                                      *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* 1. Luenberger Observer State Estimation & Innovation Residual *)
rCondModelTrackingError_mScm := rBlendedConductivity_mScm - vecX[2];

vecX[0] := vecX[0] + (rObserverGain_L0 * rCondModelTrackingError_mScm);
vecX[2] := vecX[2] + (rObserverGain_L2 * rCondModelTrackingError_mScm);

(* 2. Discrete Time State Propagation: x[k+1] = A*x[k] + B*u[k] *)
vecX[0] := (matA[0,0] * vecX[0]) + (matA[0,1] * vecX[1]) + (matB[0,0] * rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct);
vecX[1] := (matA[1,0] * vecX[0]) + (matA[1,1] * vecX[1]) + (matB[1,0] * rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct);
vecX[2] := (matA[2,2] * vecX[2]) + (matA[2,0] * vecX[0]) + (matB[2,1] * rMPC_uFlow_Optimal_mLmin);
vecX[3] := (matA[3,3] * vecX[3]) + (matB[3,1] * rMPC_uFlow_Optimal_mLmin);

(* 3. Receding Horizon Multi-Step Quadratic Optimization (N_p=5 Prediction Steps) *)
FOR iLoopIdx := 0 TO 3 DO
    vecX_Pred[iLoopIdx] := vecX[iLoopIdx];
END_FOR;

rMPC_Gradient_uB := 0.0;
FOR iLoopIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
    (* Propagate virtual state prediction forward in horizon *)
    vecX_Pred[0] := (matA[0,0] * vecX_Pred[0]) + (matB[0,0] * rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct);
    vecX_Pred[2] := (matA[2,2] * vecX_Pred[2]) + (matA[2,0] * vecX_Pred[0]);
    vecX_Pred[3] := (matA[3,3] * vecX_Pred[3]) + (matB[3,1] * rMPC_uFlow_Optimal_mLmin);

    rPredictedError_Cond := vecX_Pred[2] - rMPC_RefCond_mScm;
    rPredictedError_DP := vecX_Pred[3] - rMaxDeltaP_bar;

    (* Accumulate Quadratic Cost Gradients *)
    rMPC_Gradient_uB := rMPC_Gradient_uB + (2.0 * rMPC_WeightQ_Cond * rPredictedError_Cond * matB[0,0]);
END_FOR;

(* Add Control Effort Slew Penalty to Gradient *)
rMPC_Gradient_uB := rMPC_Gradient_uB + (2.0 * rMPC_WeightR_PumpB * (rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct - rMPC_Last_uB_pct));

(* Projected Gradient Descent Step *)
rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct := rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct - (rMPC_StepSize * rMPC_Gradient_uB);

(* Enforce Hard Operational Physical Actuator Bounds [0.0% to 100.0%] *)
IF rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct > 100.0 THEN
    rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct := 100.0;
ELSIF rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct < 0.0 THEN
    rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Actuator Slew Rate Limiter (Max 4.0% change per PLC scan cycle) *)
IF (rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct - rMPC_Last_uB_pct) > 4.0 THEN
    rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct := rMPC_Last_uB_pct + 4.0;
ELSIF (rMPC_Last_uB_pct - rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct) > 4.0 THEN
    rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct := rMPC_Last_uB_pct - 4.0;
END_IF;
rMPC_Last_uB_pct := rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct;

(* Physical Pump and Micro-Proportioning Valve Setpoint Distribution *)
IF NOT bManualOverride THEN
    rPumpB_SpeedSetp_pct := rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct;
    rPumpA_SpeedSetp_pct := 100.0 - rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct;
    rMixerValve_PosSetp_pct := rMPC_uB_Optimal_pct;
    rSystemFlowRate_mLmin := rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* FRACTION COLLECTOR DEAD-LEG VOLUMETRIC DELAY FIFO QUEUE                                              *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Push New Routing Event Into Circular Delay Buffer When Port Request Changes *)
IF (iQueuedPortPending <> arrDelayBuffer_TargetPort[iDelayBufferHead]) AND (iDelayBufferCount < 95) THEN
    iDelayBufferHead := (iDelayBufferHead + 1) MOD 100;
    arrDelayBuffer_TargetPort[iDelayBufferHead] := iQueuedPortPending;
    arrDelayBuffer_VolumeStamp_mL[iDelayBufferHead] := rCumulativeVolume_mL + rDeadVolume_mL;
    iDelayBufferCount := iDelayBufferCount + 1;
END_IF;

(* Pop and Execute Delayed Valve Routing When Target Dead Volume Has Elapsed *)
IF iDelayBufferCount > 0 THEN
    IF rCumulativeVolume_mL >= arrDelayBuffer_VolumeStamp_mL[iDelayBufferTail] THEN
        iActiveFractionIndex := arrDelayBuffer_TargetPort[iDelayBufferTail];
        iDelayBufferTail := (iDelayBufferTail + 1) MOD 100;
        iDelayBufferCount := iDelayBufferCount - 1;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Decode Discrete Solenoid Bitmask for 16-Channel Pneumatic Manifold *)
CASE iActiveFractionIndex OF
    0:  wValveClusterStateWord := 16#0001; (* Valve 0: Waste Divert *)
    1:  wValveClusterStateWord := 16#0002; (* Valve 1: Empty Capsid Pool *)
    2:  wValveClusterStateWord := 16#0004; (* Valve 2: Full Capsid Fraction 1 *)
    3:  wValveClusterStateWord := 16#0008; (* Valve 3: Full Capsid Fraction 2 *)
    4:  wValveClusterStateWord := 16#0010; (* Valve 4: Full Capsid Fraction 3 *)
    5:  wValveClusterStateWord := 16#0020; (* Valve 5: Full Capsid Fraction 4 *)
    6:  wValveClusterStateWord := 16#0040; (* Valve 6: Full Capsid Fraction 5 *)
    7:  wValveClusterStateWord := 16#0080; (* Valve 7: Full Capsid Fraction 6 *)
    8:  wValveClusterStateWord := 16#0100; (* Valve 8: Full Capsid Fraction 7 *)
    9:  wValveClusterStateWord := 16#0200; (* Valve 9: Full Capsid Fraction 8 *)
    10: wValveClusterStateWord := 16#0400; (* Valve 10: Intermediate Recycle Container *)
    11: wValveClusterStateWord := 16#0800; (* Valve 11: Regeneration Strip Receiver *)
    12: wValveClusterStateWord := 16#1000; (* Valve 12: CIP Biokill Neutralization Tank *)
ELSE
    wValveClusterStateWord := 16#0001;     (* Fail-Safe: Default to Waste *)
END_CASE;

bFullCapsidHarvestActive := (iActiveFractionIndex >= 2) AND (iActiveFractionIndex <= 9);
bEmptyCapsidDivertActive := (iActiveFractionIndex = 1);

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* MULTI-STAGE CHROMATOGRAPHIC CASE STATE MACHINE                                                       *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Accumulate Delivered Volume and Scan Time Within Current Phase *)
rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL := rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL + rDeltaVolumeCycle_mL;
IF rColumnVolume_mL > 0.1 THEN
    rPhaseDeliveredCV := rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL / rColumnVolume_mL;
END_IF;
rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

CASE iSequenceState OF

    0: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
       (* STATE 0: IDLE_SAFE                                                    *)
       (* System depressurized, zero flow, awaiting operator skid start enable.  *)
       (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin := 0.0;
        rMPC_RefCond_mScm := rBufA_Cond_mScm;
        iQueuedPortPending := 0; (* Route to waste *)
        
        IF bSkidEnable AND bEStop_SafetyOK AND NOT bCIP_SIP_ModeActive THEN
            iPreviousState := iSequenceState;
            iSequenceState := 10; (* Transition to PRE_FLUSH_EQUILIBRATION *)
            rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL := 0.0;
            rPhaseDeliveredCV := 0.0;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    10: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 10: PRE_FLUSH_EQUILIBRATION                                     *)
        (* Flush 3.0 CV of Buffer A to verify hydrodynamic stability & wet bed.  *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin := 10.0;
        rMPC_RefCond_mScm := rBufA_Cond_mScm;
        iQueuedPortPending := 0; (* Waste *)

        IF (rPhaseDeliveredCV >= 3.0) OR bManualStepAdvance THEN
            iPreviousState := iSequenceState;
            iSequenceState := 20; (* Transition to COLUMN_INTEGRITY_PRESSURE_CHECK *)
            rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL := 0.0;
            rPhaseDeliveredCV := 0.0;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 20: COLUMN_INTEGRITY_PRESSURE_CHECK                             *)
        (* Ramp to operating flow rate (15 mL/min), evaluate Darcy bed           *)
        (* permeability and delta-P to ensure resin bed is not crushed or fouled.*)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin := 15.0;
        rMPC_RefCond_mScm := rBufA_Cond_mScm;
        iQueuedPortPending := 0;

        IF (rStateTimer_s >= 30.0) THEN
            IF (rColumnDeltaP_bar > (0.85 * rMaxDeltaP_bar)) THEN
                wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0080; (* Bit 7: Resin Bed Permeability Degradation *)
            END_IF;

            iPreviousState := iSequenceState;
            iSequenceState := 30; (* Transition to EQUILIBRATION_VERIFICATION_A *)
            rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL := 0.0;
            rPhaseDeliveredCV := 0.0;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 30: EQUILIBRATION_VERIFICATION_A                                *)
        (* Check conductivity within 0.2 mS/cm of Buffer A and stable pH 8.0.   *)
        (* Tare UV detectors to perform true in-line autozero.                   *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin := 15.0;
        rMPC_RefCond_mScm := rBufA_Cond_mScm;
        iQueuedPortPending := 0;

        tEquilibrationStabilityTimer(IN := (ABS(rBlendedConductivity_mScm - rBufA_Cond_mScm) < 0.25) AND 
                                            (ABS(rInline_pH - 8.0) < 0.20), PT := T#20S);

        IF tEquilibrationStabilityTimer.Q OR bManualStepAdvance THEN
            (* Perform UV Autozero Tare *)
            rBaselineOffset260_mAU := rUV260_Voted_mAU;
            rBaselineOffset280_mAU := rUV280_Voted_mAU;

            iPreviousState := iSequenceState;
            iSequenceState := 40; (* Transition to SAMPLE_LOADING_AND_FRONT_TRACKING *)
            rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL := 0.0;
            rPhaseDeliveredCV := 0.0;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            rCumulatedLoadedGenome_vg := 0.0;
            rCumulativeTotalLoadedMass_mg := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 40: SAMPLE_LOADING_AND_FRONT_TRACKING                           *)
        (* Feed crude clarified lysate containing mixed AAV full/empty capsids. *)
        (* Continuous Bohart-Adams binding front integration. Flow through goes  *)
        (* to Waste/Recycle. Terminates upon recipe volume or saturation warning.*)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin := 12.0; (* Lower flow rate to maximize residence time & dynamic capacity *)
        rMPC_RefCond_mScm := rBufA_Cond_mScm;
        iQueuedPortPending := 0; (* Unbound impurities to waste *)

        IF (rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL >= 250.0) OR bBindingSaturationWarning OR bManualStepAdvance THEN
            iPreviousState := iSequenceState;
            iSequenceState := 50; (* Transition to POST_LOAD_WASH_CHASE *)
            rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL := 0.0;
            rPhaseDeliveredCV := 0.0;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    50: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 50: POST_LOAD_WASH_CHASE                                        *)
        (* Flush with 4.0 CV of Buffer A to chase unadsorbed cellular proteins,  *)
        (* residual host cell DNA, and culture media components to waste.        *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin := 15.0;
        rMPC_RefCond_mScm := rBufA_Cond_mScm;
        iQueuedPortPending := 0;

        IF ((rPhaseDeliveredCV >= 4.0) AND bBaselineReturnDetected) OR bManualStepAdvance THEN
            iPreviousState := iSequenceState;
            iSequenceState := 60; (* Transition to INTERMEDIATE_WASH_SALT_STEP1 *)
            rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL := 0.0;
            rPhaseDeliveredCV := 0.0;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    60: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 60: INTERMEDIATE_WASH_SALT_STEP1                                *)
        (* Step conductivity to 8.5 mS/cm to selectively elute weakly bound      *)
        (* non-specifically adsorbed host cell proteins and fragmented capsids.  *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin := 15.0;
        rMPC_RefCond_mScm := rTargetSaltStep1_mScm;
        iQueuedPortPending := 0; (* Contaminants diverted to waste *)

        IF (rPhaseDeliveredCV >= 3.0) OR bManualStepAdvance THEN
            iPreviousState := iSequenceState;
            iSequenceState := 70; (* Transition to EMPTY_CAPSID_DESORPTION_RAMP *)
            rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL := 0.0;
            rPhaseDeliveredCV := 0.0;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            rStepGradientBaseConductivity := rBlendedConductivity_mScm;
        END_IF;

    70: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 70: EMPTY_CAPSID_DESORPTION_RAMP                                *)
        (* Linear ramp or step toward 14.5 mS/cm. Quaternary ammonium resin      *)
        (* desorbs Empty capsids first due to their higher pI (~6.3 vs 5.9).    *)
        (* UV 260/280 ratio reads ~0.60 to 0.70. Route to Empty Pool (Port 1).   *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin := 12.0; (* Slow flow for sharp resolution *)
        
        (* Apply linear conductivity ramp *)
        rMPC_RefCond_mScm := rStepGradientBaseConductivity + (rGradientRampRate_mScm_per_CV * rPhaseDeliveredCV);
        IF rMPC_RefCond_mScm > rTargetSaltStep2_mScm THEN
            rMPC_RefCond_mScm := rTargetSaltStep2_mScm;
        END_IF;

        (* Detect Empty Capsid Peak Liftoff *)
        IF bPeakLiftoffDetected AND (rUV_Ratio_260_280 < 0.95) THEN
            iQueuedPortPending := 1; (* Empty Capsid Collection Pool *)
        END_IF;

        (* Detect Valley Nadir: Signal returned down after empty capsid peak *)
        IF bValleyNadirDetected OR (rPhaseDeliveredCV >= 6.0) OR bManualStepAdvance THEN
            iQueuedPortPending := 0; (* Divert inter-peak valley to waste *)
            iPreviousState := iSequenceState;
            iSequenceState := 80; (* Transition to ISOCRATIC_VALLEY_NADIR_HOLD *)
            rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL := 0.0;
            rPhaseDeliveredCV := 0.0;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    80: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 80: ISOCRATIC_VALLEY_NADIR_HOLD                                 *)
        (* Hold conductivity constant at ~16.0 mS/cm to allow empty capsid tail  *)
        (* to wash out completely before initiating full capsid elution.         *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin := 12.0;
        rMPC_RefCond_mScm := rTargetSaltStep3_mScm;
        iQueuedPortPending := 0; (* Inter-peak valley fluid to waste *)

        tGradientHoldTimer(IN := (iSequenceState = 80), PT := T#45S);

        IF tGradientHoldTimer.Q OR (rPhaseDeliveredCV >= 2.0) OR bManualStepAdvance THEN
            iPreviousState := iSequenceState;
            iSequenceState := 90; (* Transition to FULL_CAPSID_ELUTION_STEP2 *)
            rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL := 0.0;
            rPhaseDeliveredCV := 0.0;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            iSubState := 0;
        END_IF;

    90: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* STATE 90: FULL_CAPSID_ELUTION_STEP2                                   *)
        (* Step conductivity to 21.0 mS/cm. Full AAV capsids with viral genome   *)
        (* package desorb cleanly. UV 260/280 ratio exceeds 1.30. Synchronize    *)
        (* fraction collector manifold across vials 2 through 8.                 *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin := 10.0; (* Low shear rate to protect capsid integrity *)
        rMPC_RefCond_mScm := rTargetSaltStep4_mScm;

        (* Sub-state peak slicing for multi-vial fraction collection *)
        CASE iSubState OF
            0: (* Waiting for Full Peak Liftoff *)
                IF bPeakLiftoffDetected AND (rUV_Ratio_260_280 >= 1.15) THEN
                    iQueuedPortPending := 2; (* Route to Full Harvest Vial 1 *)
                    iSubState := 1;
                ELSE
                    iQueuedPortPending := 0;
                END_IF;

            1: (* Leading Shoulder: Harvesting Vial 1 *)
                IF (rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL >= 2.5) THEN
                    iQueuedPortPending := 3; (* Route to Full Harvest Vial 2 (Peak Apex) *)
                    iSubState := 2;
                END_IF;

            2: (* Peak Apex: Harvesting Vial 2 *)
                IF bPeakApexDetected OR (rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL >= 5.0) THEN
                    iQueuedPortPending := 4; (* Route to Full Harvest Vial 3 *)
                    iSubState := 3;
                END_IF;

            3: (* Trailing Shoulder: Harvesting Vial 3 *)
                IF (rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL >= 7.5) THEN
                    iQueuedPortPending := 5; (* Route to Full Harvest Vial 4 *)
                    iSubState := 4;
                END_IF;

            4: (* Peak Descent / Tail *)
                IF bBaselineReturnDetected OR (rPhaseDeliveredCV >= 5.0) THEN
                    iQueuedPortPending := 0; (* Divert to waste *)
                    iSubState := 5;
                END_IF;
        END_CASE;

        IF (iSubState = 5) OR (rPhaseDeliveredCV >= 6.0) OR bManualStepAdvance THEN
            iPreviousState := iSequenceState;
            iSequenceState := 100; (* Transition to HIGH_SALT_STRIP_REGENERATION *)
            rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL := 0.0;
            rPhaseDeliveredCV := 0.0;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            iSubState := 0;
        END_IF;

    100: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
         (* STATE 100: HIGH_SALT_STRIP_REGENERATION                              *)
         (* 100% Buffer B (~95-105 mS/cm, 1.0M NaCl) to strip tightly bound      *)
         (* aggregates, adventitious DNA, and residual proteins from Q resin.     *)
         (* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin := 15.0;
        rMPC_RefCond_mScm := rBufB_Cond_mScm;
        iQueuedPortPending := 11; (* Route to Regeneration Strip Waste Tank *)

        IF (rPhaseDeliveredCV >= 4.0) OR bManualStepAdvance THEN
            iPreviousState := iSequenceState;
            iSequenceState := 110; (* Transition to CIP_SANITATION_05M_NAOH *)
            rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL := 0.0;
            rPhaseDeliveredCV := 0.0;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    110: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
         (* STATE 110: CIP_SANITATION_05M_NAOH                                   *)
         (* Clean-In-Place: 0.5M Sodium Hydroxide contact time for bioburden kill *)
         (* and endotoxin depyrogenation. Route effluent to Biokill Tank (12).   *)
         (* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin := 6.0; (* Low contact velocity *)
        rMPC_RefCond_mScm := 120.0; (* High caustic conductivity *)
        iQueuedPortPending := 12; (* Biokill dump *)

        tCIPSoakTimer(IN := (iSequenceState = 110), PT := T#900S); (* 15 min soak *)

        IF tCIPSoakTimer.Q OR bManualStepAdvance THEN
            iPreviousState := iSequenceState;
            iSequenceState := 120; (* Transition to POST_CIP_NEUTRALIZATION_FLUSH *)
            rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL := 0.0;
            rPhaseDeliveredCV := 0.0;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    120: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
         (* STATE 120: POST_CIP_NEUTRALIZATION_FLUSH                             *)
         (* Flush with Buffer A until effluent pH drops below 7.5 and             *)
         (* conductivity stabilizes back to 2.5 mS/cm.                            *)
         (* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin := 15.0;
        rMPC_RefCond_mScm := rBufA_Cond_mScm;
        iQueuedPortPending := 0;

        IF (rPhaseDeliveredCV >= 5.0) AND (rInline_pH <= 7.5) AND 
           (ABS(rBlendedConductivity_mScm - rBufA_Cond_mScm) < 0.3) THEN
            iPreviousState := iSequenceState;
            iSequenceState := 0; (* Return safely to IDLE_SAFE *)
            rPhaseDeliveredVolume_mL := 0.0;
            rPhaseDeliveredCV := 0.0;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    130: (* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
         (* STATE 130: EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN_HALT                                  *)
         (* Fail-safe lock state. Master bypass energized, pumps inhibited.       *)
         (* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rMPC_RefFlow_mLmin := 0.0;
        rMPC_RefCond_mScm := 0.0;
        iQueuedPortPending := 0;
        rPumpA_SpeedSetp_pct := 0.0;
        rPumpB_SpeedSetp_pct := 0.0;

END_CASE;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* MASS BALANCE, RECOVERY YIELD, AND CONCENTRATION INTEGRATION                                          *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Full Capsid Harvest Integration *)
IF bFullCapsidHarvestActive THEN
    rCumulativeFullMassHarvest_mg := rCumulativeFullMassHarvest_mg + 
        (rCapsidConcentration_Full_mgmL * rDeltaVolumeCycle_mL);
END_IF;

(* Empty Capsid Waste Integration *)
IF bEmptyCapsidDivertActive THEN
    rCumulativeEmptyMassDump_mg := rCumulativeEmptyMassDump_mg + 
        (rCapsidConcentration_Empty_mgmL * rDeltaVolumeCycle_mL);
END_IF;

(* Recovery Yield Calculation Against Estimated Load Mass *)
IF rCumulativeTotalLoadedMass_mg > 0.0001 THEN
    rEstimatedRecoveryYield_pct := (rCumulativeFullMassHarvest_mg / rCumulativeTotalLoadedMass_mg) * 100.0;
    IF rEstimatedRecoveryYield_pct > 100.0 THEN
        rEstimatedRecoveryYield_pct := 100.0; (* Clamp numerical rounding *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rEstimatedRecoveryYield_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* STATUS WORDS & FAULT DIAGNOSTICS ENCODING                                                            *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Pack Hexadecimal Skid State Word (ISA-88 State + Operational Flags) *)
wSkidStateWord := INT_TO_WORD(iSequenceState);
IF bFullCapsidHarvestActive THEN
    wSkidStateWord := wSkidStateWord OR 16#0100; (* Bit 8: Full Capsid Harvest Active *)
END_IF;
IF bEmptyCapsidDivertActive THEN
    wSkidStateWord := wSkidStateWord OR 16#0200; (* Bit 9: Empty Capsid Divert Active *)
END_IF;
IF bWarningDegradedSensorMode THEN
    wSkidStateWord := wSkidStateWord OR 16#0400; (* Bit 10: TMR Sensor Degradation Mode *)
END_IF;
IF bSystemSafeHalt THEN
    wSkidStateWord := wSkidStateWord OR 16#8000; (* Bit 15: Skid System Safe Halt Tripped *)
END_IF;

(* Manual Alarm Reset / Acknowledge Strobe Handling *)
IF bAckAlarms THEN
    wPrimaryAlarmWord := 16#0000;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := 16#0000;
    bWarningDegradedSensorMode := FALSE;
    bBindingSaturationWarning := FALSE;
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
